description: This file defines an in-memory rate limiting middleware for a web application using Starlette. It includes a class `RateLimitMiddleware` that enforces request limits over a sliding time window, based on a key function.

classes.name: RateLimitMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that applies rate limiting per client key over a specified window.

methods.name: __init__( self, app, requests: int, window_seconds: int, key_func: Callable[[dict], str], )
methods.description: Initializes the RateLimitMiddleware with application, request limit, window size, and key function.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next)
methods.description: Handles each incoming request, enforces rate limiting, updates request timestamps, and adds rate limit headers to responses.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, app, requests: int, window_seconds: int, key_func: Callable[[dict], str], )

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):$/
